question: Find the lateral surface area of ​​a cube of side length 5 cm.
solution:
The correct answer is __100 cm ²__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The formula to calculate the lateral surface area of a cube is 4 × side²__.
 
• Given the side length of the cube is 5 cm.
 
• Substituting the value in the formula: 4 × 5² = 4 × 25 = 100 cm².
 
• Thus, the lateral surface area of the cube is 100 cm².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lateral Surface Area:**

 
 
• The lateral surface area of a cube refers to the total area of the four vertical faces.
 
• It does not include the top and bottom faces.
 
 
 
• **Cube Properties:**
 
 
• A cube has 6 square faces, all of equal area.
 
• The edges of a cube are equal in length.
